_comment: Known problems for the US Camry, prompt section 7. Every issue cites NHTSA recalls (campaign numbers), NHTSA manufacturer communications (TSB / document ids) and/or NHTSA complaint symptom patterns computed in staging (complaint_symptom_counts.json). Texts paraphrase the cited records only. Probability rule: COMMON = complaint pattern >= threshold AND TSB; OCCASIONAL = pattern OR TSB; RARE = recall only, limited population. NHTSA complaints carry no engine field: complaint counts are per generation/model year, never per engine.

issues.title: Low-pressure fuel pump failure can stall the engine
symptoms: Engine may not restart after stalling
issues.cause: The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail (recall 25V028000 wording); recalls 20V012000 and 20V682000 replace the fuel pump assembly with an improved one.
issues.consequences: If the fuel pump fails, the engine can stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN with a Toyota dealer or NHTSA whether recall remedies 20V012000, 20V682000 or 25V028000 apply and were completed; ask for the fuel pump replacement record.
issues.typical_fix: Fuel pump assembly replaced free of charge under the recall.

issues.title: Brake booster vacuum pump failure: sudden loss of brake assist
symptoms: Sudden loss of power brake assist; harder brake pedal
issues.cause: Recall 18V211000: improperly machined oil galley in the vacuum pump rotor (2018). Recall 21V890000: the vane cap inside the vacuum pump may break (2018-2019).
issues.consequences: A sudden loss of braking assist can increase the risk of a crash.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recalls 18V211000 and 21V890000 apply and were completed (vacuum pump repaired or replaced).
issues.typical_fix: Brake booster vacuum pump repaired or replaced free of charge under the recall.

issues.title: Hesitation on acceleration from a slow roll (A25A engine)
symptoms: Hesitation when accelerating from a slow roll or rolling stop at 6 mph or below, right after a 3-to-1 downshift, with less than 40% accelerator pedal
issues.cause: Engine control module (ECM/PCM) logic; Toyota modified the calibration to reduce the potential for hesitation (TSB 10173797).
issues.consequences: Delayed response when pulling away from a rolling stop.
issues.inspection: On a test drive, slow to a roll and accelerate gently; ask whether the ECM calibration update from TSB 10173797 was applied.
issues.typical_fix: ECM calibration update per the bulletin repair procedure.

issues.title: Electric water pump coolant leak or malfunction indicator with water pump codes
symptoms: Malfunction indicator lamp ON with DTC P26CB71, P26CA14 and/or P26CA31
Coolant leak from the electric water pump body or electrical connector
issues.cause: Electric water pump body or connector leak (TSB/technical tip 10176705).
issues.consequences: Coolant loss; malfunction indicator lamp on.
issues.inspection: Check for coolant traces at the electric water pump and connector, scan for P26CB71/P26CA14/P26CA31, check coolant level when cold.

issues.title: Engine block casting porosity can crack and leak coolant (2.5 L)
issues.cause: Porosity in the engine castings may result in cracks that allow coolant to leak (recall 20V064000).
issues.consequences: Overheating and stall in conventional gasoline vehicles; possible mechanical engine damage and oil leak with fire risk.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 20V064000 applies and the engine inspection/replacement was done.
issues.typical_fix: Engine (including block) inspected and replaced as necessary free of charge.

issues.title: Oversized pistons may stall the 2.5 L engine (2018)
issues.consequences: An engine stall can increase the risk of a crash.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 18V200000 applies; the remedy replaces the engine assembly when affected pistons are found.
issues.typical_fix: Engine assembly replaced free of charge if the pistons are from the affected production period.

issues.title: V6 fuel delivery pipes may not be properly connected (2018)
symptoms: Fuel smell or visible fuel leak in the engine compartment
issues.cause: Fuel delivery pipes not properly connected to the fuel hoses (recall 18V108000).
issues.consequences: Fuel leak with an ignition source increases the risk of fire.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 18V108000 applies and the fuel pipe inspection was completed.
issues.typical_fix: Dealer inspects and corrects the fuel pipe connections free of charge.

issues.title: Chirping noise from the high-pressure fuel pump (2GR-FKS)
symptoms: Chirping noise from the high-pressure fuel pump
issues.cause: Described in Toyota bulletin 10130004 for 2GR-FKS engines.
issues.consequences: Noise complaint; no safety consequence stated in the bulletin.
issues.inspection: Listen at idle with the hood open for a chirp from the high-pressure fuel pump area.

issues.title: Whine or grind noise from the 8-speed transmission (2021)
symptoms: Whine or grind noise from the transmission
issues.cause: Front carrier assembly pinion shafts (TSB 10188917, UA80E or UA80F transmissions).
issues.consequences: Transmission repair under the bulletin procedure.
issues.inspection: On a test drive listen for whine or grind under acceleration and coasting; ask whether TSB 10188917 work was done.
issues.note: The bulletin names UA80E or UA80F without mapping them to Camry FWD/AWD; transmission key left empty.

issues.title: Occupant Classification System sensor short: front passenger air bag may not deploy
symptoms: Air bag warning / passenger air bag status abnormal
issues.cause: A short circuit may develop in the Occupant Classification System sensor (recall 23V865000).
issues.consequences: An air bag that does not deploy during a crash increases the risk of injury.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 23V865000 applies and the sensor inspection/replacement was done.
issues.typical_fix: Sensor inspected and replaced as necessary free of charge.

issues.title: Torque converter shudder (U760E 6-speed automatic)
symptoms: Brief intermittent shudder during torque converter flex lock-up under light throttle at about 25-50 mph
issues.cause: Torque converter (Toyota Warranty Enhancement Program, document 10109476).
issues.consequences: Repair of the torque converter; Toyota extended warranty coverage for this condition.
issues.inspection: Test drive at 25-50 mph with light throttle and feel for a shudder; ask for torque converter repair records.
issues.typical_fix: Torque converter repair under the warranty enhancement program.
issues.note: The program document covers model years 2012-2014; owner complaints mentioning shudder or torque converter continue for 2015-2017 (see pattern counts) without a manufacturer document.

issues.title: Electric power steering ECU damage: possible loss of power steering (2015)
symptoms: Unexpected loss of power steering assist
issues.cause: A component of the EPS electronic control unit may have been damaged during manufacturing (recall 15V144000).
issues.consequences: An unexpected loss of power steering increases the risk of a crash.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 15V144000 applies and the EPS ECU serial-number inspection was done.
issues.typical_fix: EPS ECU replaced free of charge when the serial number is in the affected range.

issues.title: Left front lower arm may separate from the ball joint (2014, 16/17-inch rims)
issues.cause: Left-side front lower arm incorrectly manufactured; insufficient clamping surface for a ball-joint bolt (recall 14V715000).
issues.consequences: The lower arm may separate from the ball joint, increasing the risk of a crash.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 14V715000 applies and the left lower arm was replaced.
issues.typical_fix: Left side lower arm replaced free of charge.

issues.title: Fuel delivery pipe may leak in the engine compartment (2014)
symptoms: Fuel smell or visible fuel leak in the engine compartment
issues.cause: Fuel may leak from one of the fuel delivery pipes (recall 14V576000).
issues.consequences: A fuel leak with an ignition source increases the risk of fire.
issues.inspection: Check by VIN whether recall 14V576000 applies and the suspect fuel delivery pipes were replaced.
issues.typical_fix: Suspect fuel delivery pipes replaced free of charge.
